## FAQs

Do I need a resale license to open a Wholesale Account?

No, decorators without a resale license are welcome to register for a Makers Account; however, only
licensed resellers, commercial screen printers and promotional product distributors are eligible for
waived sales tax.

Are there order minimums?

Domestic shipments do not have any minimum order quantities. International orders must order by the
case.

How long will it take to process my order?

Please allow 1-2 business days for orders to fully process prior to shipment. For same day shipping,
orders must be placed by the below times:
* Maryland warehouse — same day shipping cutoff time Ground 4 PM EST and Expedited 2:00 PM EST.
* Nevada warehouse — same day shipping cutoff time Ground 4 PM PST and Expedited 2:00 PM PST.

What payment methods are available?

We accept credit cards (Visa, MasterCard and American Express). Credit cards will be charged upon
shipment of order.

Contact [cs@bellacanvas.com][141] about other payment methods such as Wire Transfer.

Licensed resellers, commercial screen printers, and promotional product distributors may also submit
a [Credit Application][142], however, you must allow 24-48 hours for factor approval.

Please contact customer support at [cs@bellacanvas.com][143] or [855-363-2200][144] if you have any
questions regarding payment methods.

How do I request a physical catalog or color card?

2026 printed Color Cards and Catalogs are coming soon. [ Submit a request][145] to receive one by
mail in the next 2-3 weeks. Quantities are limited and will be fulfilled on a first-come,
first-served basis once available.

In the meantime, check out our [Digital Catalog][146] and [Digital Color Card][147].

## FAQs

Do I need a resale license to open a Wholesale Account?

No, decorators without a resale license are welcome to register for a Makers Account; however, only
licensed resellers, commercial screen printers and promotional product distributors are eligible for
waived sales tax.

Are there order minimums?

Domestic shipments do not have any minimum order quantities. International orders must order by the
case.

How long will it take to process my order?

Please allow 1-2 business days for orders to fully process prior to shipment. For same day shipping,
orders must be placed by the below times:
* Maryland warehouse — same day shipping cutoff time Ground 4 PM EST and Expedited 2:00 PM EST.
* Nevada warehouse — same day shipping cutoff time Ground 4 PM PST and Expedited 2:00 PM PST.

What payment methods are available?

We accept credit cards (Visa, MasterCard and American Express). Credit cards will be charged upon
shipment of order.

Contact [cs@bellacanvas.com][141] about other payment methods such as Wire Transfer.

Licensed resellers, commercial screen printers, and promotional product distributors may also submit
a [Credit Application][142], however, you must allow 24-48 hours for factor approval.

Please contact customer support at [cs@bellacanvas.com][143] or [855-363-2200][144] if you have any
questions regarding payment methods.

How do I request a physical catalog or color card?

2026 printed Color Cards and Catalogs are coming soon. [ Submit a request][145] to receive one by
mail in the next 2-3 weeks. Quantities are limited and will be fulfilled on a first-come,
first-served basis once available.

In the meantime, check out our [Digital Catalog][146] and [Digital Color Card][147].

Let’s get real. You didn’t come here for off-the-rack nonsense. Our customized apparel manufacturing
turns your concept into couture (well, maybe not couture, but close). It’s personal, it’s premium,
and it’s made for those who don’t believe in shortcuts.

### Our Mission

Our mission is to simplify apparel on quality, customer satisfaction, and innovation. We empower
brands to bring their ideas to life smoothly, offering a one-stop shop for all their manufacturing
needs. Whether start-up or established, we aim to support business growth and success through
reliable and efficient services.

### Our Vision

At Argus Apparel, our vision is clear: to deliver exceptional quality through ethical manufacturing
practices, guaranteeing the happiness of our employees and customers alike. We strive to be a
trusted partner globally, exceeding expectations with every product and service we offer.

[ EXPLORE NOW ][117]

Uncompromising Quality

## An American Clothing Manufacturer That Cares

We are here to talk business, delivering you the best that others can only promise. We understand
that with your unique story, you are looking for something special, different, and magical.

Whether it’s your style, your brand, or your story, it’s unique. Why force it into a mold? We design
and manufacture custom apparel that’s as individual as you are, with the kind of craftsmanship that
fits every idea.

Custom clothing manufacturing with us isn’t a chore; it’s an experience. We create magic that is
reflected in each article of your product line. For dreamers, we are turning ambitions into a
reality.

## Custom Apparel Manufacturing

We know that you are tired of the same old, same old. But we have a fix for you. We’re here to
inject life into your brand. From bold graphics to subtle elegance, we’ll take your vision and turn
it into wearable art.

Why settle for cookie-cutter suppliers when you can collaborate with a partner who gets it? Argus,
the name calls for the spirit we bring in to make your custom clothing manufacturing experience like
no other.

We specialize in custom manufacturing tailored to your brand’s DNA. Whether you’re a bold startup or
an established name, we’ll take your vision and make it runway (or retail rack) ready.

[ Start Your Journey ][119]

### Real Clients. Real Results.

Argus Apparel turned my concept into a collection.

As a designer building my first label, I had ideas but needed a partner who could guide me through
production. Argus Apparel delivered at every stage from fabric sourcing to final fit. They brought
my vision to life.
* Expert help from concept to final product
* Trusted by first-time designers & growing brands
* Premium manufacturing that matches your energy

[ INQUIRE NOW ][120]
**— Liam Carter, Founder & Designer**

## Creating Custom Clothing Businesses That Are Built to Last

Creativity can’t be mass-produced. The world doesn’t need another mass-market clone. What it needs
is you. We collaborate with individuals and brands to create custom clothing masterpieces that
refuse to conform. Your story, your rules—made to measure.
[ SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION NOW ][121]

From Idea to Manufacturing

## Don't Just Source—Partner

Let’s cut to the chase. Your custom apparel ideas are waiting to happen, and we’re ready to make
them real. Hit us up if you’re ready to go from “just another brand” to “unforgettable.” Forget
faceless transactions. We value long-term partnerships with brands that are as passionate about
design and quality as we are. Ready to scale your vision?

[ INQUIRE NOW ][122]

Quality, Service, and Customization

## MOQ? Niche Requests? Consider It Done

We get it; it’s a hassle for you as a start-up to find custom clothing manufacturers that wouldn’t
charge you an arm and a leg. Small-batch or bulk production, sustainable fabrics, or intricate
embroidery—we’ve got the expertise to meet your demands. From development to production, we charge
you the lowest possible rates, with no hidden charges. You dream it; we manufacture it (and deliver
with zero excuses).

[ INQUIRE NOW ][123]

### Our Manufacturing Process – From Concept to Delivery

At Argus Apparel, we aim to provide you with a seamless deployment of your products. Our process is
built to give you complete confidence. From your first idea to the moment your products are ready
for market. Every stage is managed with precision, transparency, and our commitment to quality.

1.

##### Design & Concept

We start by understanding your brand’s vision, target audience, and product goals. Our design team
translates your ideas into detailed technical specifications, ensuring every seam, measurement, and
feature is clearly defined. This collaborative foundation ensures your products are both functional
and on-brand.

2.

##### Material Sourcing – Quality from the Start

We collaborate with trusted suppliers in the USA and worldwide to source the finest fabrics, trims,
and hardware. If you’re looking for sustainable textiles, performance materials, or specialized
finishes, every choice reflects your quality standards and production needs.

3.

##### Prototyping – Your First Look

Once designs and materials are confirmed, we produce a precision prototype. This sample lets you
review fit, feel, and craftsmanship before full production begins. Any refinements are made here to
ensure perfection.

4.

##### Sample Approval – Your Sign-Off Matters

We send you the sample for evaluation, giving you the chance to assess its look, performance, and
brand alignment. Production moves forward only after your approval, ensuring no surprises later.

5.

##### Mass Production – Scaled with Consistency

Our skilled production team and advanced equipment deliver your products at the agreed quantity,
whether it’s a small launch or a large run. Consistency in quality is maintained across every piece.

6.

##### Quality Control – Every Detail Checked

Our QC specialists inspect each product for flawless stitching, correct branding placement, perfect
alignment, and overall durability. We check for both appearance and function to ensure your
expectations are met.

7.

##### Packaging & Shipping – Ready for the Market

Your products are packaged to your specifications, from custom branding to retail-ready
presentation. We manage worldwide shipping to ensure safe, on-time delivery to your destination.

quality, efficiency, and customization to help your brand stand out.

to life? You have come to the right place! Argus Apparel collaborates closely with new startups and
designers like you to transform your vision into reality – from fabric sourcing to apparel
manufacturing. We provide a complete solution for custom clothing manufacturing in the USA. From
start to finish, we do it all. Whatever the size of your clothing line or whatever the
specifications are for your clothing, quality apparel is just a conversation away.

## Design. Create. Launch.

Let’s get real. You didn’t come here for off-the-rack nonsense. Our customized apparel manufacturing
turns your concept into couture (well, maybe not couture, but close). It’s personal, it’s premium,
and it’s made for those who don’t believe in shortcuts.

### Our Mission

Our mission is to simplify apparel on quality, customer satisfaction, and innovation. We empower
brands to bring their ideas to life smoothly, offering a one-stop shop for all their manufacturing
needs. Whether start-up or established, we aim to support business growth and success through
reliable and efficient services.

### Our Vision

At Argus Apparel, our vision is clear: to deliver exceptional quality through ethical manufacturing
practices, guaranteeing the happiness of our employees and customers alike. We strive to be a
trusted partner globally, exceeding expectations with every product and service we offer.

[ EXPLORE NOW ][117]

Uncompromising Quality

## An American Clothing Manufacturer That Cares

We are here to talk business, delivering you the best that others can only promise. We understand
that with your unique story, you are looking for something special, different, and magical.

Whether it’s your style, your brand, or your story, it’s unique. Why force it into a mold? We design
and manufacture custom apparel that’s as individual as you are, with the kind of craftsmanship that
fits every idea.

Custom clothing manufacturing with us isn’t a chore; it’s an experience. We create magic that is
reflected in each article of your product line. For dreamers, we are turning ambitions into a
reality.

[ Start Your Journey ][118]

Redefining the Art of

## Custom Apparel Manufacturing

We know that you are tired of the same old, same old. But we have a fix for you. We’re here to
inject life into your brand. From bold graphics to subtle elegance, we’ll take your vision and turn
it into wearable art.

Why settle for cookie-cutter suppliers when you can collaborate with a partner who gets it? Argus,
the name calls for the spirit we bring in to make your custom clothing manufacturing experience like
no other.

We specialize in custom manufacturing tailored to your brand’s DNA. Whether you’re a bold startup or
an established name, we’ll take your vision and make it runway (or retail rack) ready.

[ Start Your Journey ][119]

### Real Clients. Real Results.

Argus Apparel turned my concept into a collection.

As a designer building my first label, I had ideas but needed a partner who could guide me through
production. Argus Apparel delivered at every stage from fabric sourcing to final fit. They brought
my vision to life.
* Expert help from concept to final product
* Trusted by first-time designers & growing brands
* Premium manufacturing that matches your energy

[ INQUIRE NOW ][120]
**— Liam Carter, Founder & Designer**

## Creating Custom Clothing Businesses That Are Built to Last

Creativity can’t be mass-produced. The world doesn’t need another mass-market clone. What it needs
is you. We collaborate with individuals and brands to create custom clothing masterpieces that
refuse to conform. Your story, your rules—made to measure.
[ SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION NOW ][121]

From Idea to Manufacturing

## Don't Just Source—Partner

Let’s cut to the chase. Your custom apparel ideas are waiting to happen, and we’re ready to make
them real. Hit us up if you’re ready to go from “just another brand” to “unforgettable.” Forget
faceless transactions. We value long-term partnerships with brands that are as passionate about
design and quality as we are. Ready to scale your vision?

[ INQUIRE NOW ][122]

Quality, Service, and Customization

## MOQ? Niche Requests? Consider It Done

We get it; it’s a hassle for you as a start-up to find custom clothing manufacturers that wouldn’t
charge you an arm and a leg. Small-batch or bulk production, sustainable fabrics, or intricate
embroidery—we’ve got the expertise to meet your demands. From development to production, we charge
you the lowest possible rates, with no hidden charges. You dream it; we manufacture it (and deliver
with zero excuses).

[ INQUIRE NOW ][123]

### Our Manufacturing Process – From Concept to Delivery

At Argus Apparel, we aim to provide you with a seamless deployment of your products. Our process is
built to give you complete confidence. From your first idea to the moment your products are ready
for market. Every stage is managed with precision, transparency, and our commitment to quality.

1.

##### Design & Concept

We start by understanding your brand’s vision, target audience, and product goals. Our design team
translates your ideas into detailed technical specifications, ensuring every seam, measurement, and
feature is clearly defined. This collaborative foundation ensures your products are both functional
and on-brand.

2.

##### Material Sourcing – Quality from the Start

We collaborate with trusted suppliers in the USA and worldwide to source the finest fabrics, trims,
and hardware. If you’re looking for sustainable textiles, performance materials, or specialized
finishes, every choice reflects your quality standards and production needs.

3.

##### Prototyping – Your First Look

Once designs and materials are confirmed, we produce a precision prototype. This sample lets you
review fit, feel, and craftsmanship before full production begins. Any refinements are made here to
ensure perfection.

4.

##### Sample Approval – Your Sign-Off Matters

We send you the sample for evaluation, giving you the chance to assess its look, performance, and
brand alignment. Production moves forward only after your approval, ensuring no surprises later.

5.

##### Mass Production – Scaled with Consistency

Our skilled production team and advanced equipment deliver your products at the agreed quantity,
whether it’s a small launch or a large run. Consistency in quality is maintained across every piece.

6.

##### Quality Control – Every Detail Checked

Our QC specialists inspect each product for flawless stitching, correct branding placement, perfect
alignment, and overall durability. We check for both appearance and function to ensure your
expectations are met.

7.

##### Packaging & Shipping – Ready for the Market

Your products are packaged to your specifications, from custom branding to retail-ready
presentation. We manage worldwide shipping to ensure safe, on-time delivery to your destination.

[ SEND US A MESSAGE ][124]

## A Custom Apparel Company That Understands You

Join hands with us to get premium apparel solutions that meet your business needs, combining
quality, efficiency, and customization to help your brand stand out.

Why Bangladesh
[Learn More][75]
There are innumerable people who haven’t yet visited Bangladesh but felt its warmth by the virtue of
world-class apparel made by the country. Garments with “Made in Bangladesh” tag reach people of all
ages in more than 150 countries, essentially providing with their second skin, keeping them warm
during winter, comfortable in summer and trendy in autumn. Choose Bangladesh as your sole green and
compliant hub for sourcing.
[Learn More][76]

**EXPERIENCE**

35+ years of experience in apparel manufacturing, With 4000+ factories Bangladesh is serving all
major global fashion brands.

**COMPLIANT**

All factories maintain international safety and compliance, and assessed in accordance with BSCI,
WRAP, SMETA, ICS, Higg index, GTW, RTM, Join Life, ZDHC, Blue Sign, ISO, OCS, GOTS, Oekotex.

**COMPETITIVE**

Duty-free Market Access to EU, Experienced Labour Force, and International Quality.

**TRUSTED SOURCING HUB**

More than 150 countries import apparel from Bangladesh.

**PRODUCTION FACILITIES**

Factories equipped with latest machinery and technologies to meet the demand of latest fashion
trends.

**GREEN FACTORIES**

Home to world’s highest number of Green Factories. These factories use energy-efficient and
environment-friendly technology and practices that save water, energy and minimize pollution.

Why Bangladesh
[Learn More][75]
There are innumerable people who haven’t yet visited Bangladesh but felt its warmth by the virtue of
world-class apparel made by the country. Garments with “Made in Bangladesh” tag reach people of all
ages in more than 150 countries, essentially providing with their second skin, keeping them warm
during winter, comfortable in summer and trendy in autumn. Choose Bangladesh as your sole green and
compliant hub for sourcing.
[Learn More][76]

**EXPERIENCE**

35+ years of experience in apparel manufacturing, With 4000+ factories Bangladesh is serving all
major global fashion brands.

**COMPLIANT**

All factories maintain international safety and compliance, and assessed in accordance with BSCI,
WRAP, SMETA, ICS, Higg index, GTW, RTM, Join Life, ZDHC, Blue Sign, ISO, OCS, GOTS, Oekotex.

**COMPETITIVE**

Duty-free Market Access to EU, Experienced Labour Force, and International Quality.

**TRUSTED SOURCING HUB**

More than 150 countries import apparel from Bangladesh.

**PRODUCTION FACILITIES**

Factories equipped with latest machinery and technologies to meet the demand of latest fashion
trends.

**GREEN FACTORIES**

Home to world’s highest number of Green Factories. These factories use energy-efficient and
environment-friendly technology and practices that save water, energy and minimize pollution.

## Why Brands Choose BOMME

### Proven Manufacturing Expertise

We produce apparel for established fashion, streetwear, activewear, and lifestyle brands that
require consistent quality and dependable execution.

### Full-Service Apparel Production

From development to delivery, our team handles every stage of the clothing manufacturing process
through disciplined workflows and transparent communication.

### High-Quality Standards

Every garment is produced with rigorous quality control across development, sampling, and final
production.

### Los Angeles–Based Production

As a clothing manufacturer in Los Angeles, we offer proximity, accountability, and the ability to
manage programs that require hands-on oversight.

### Trusted USA & Global Partners

Our vetted network of cutting, sewing, fabric, transportation and specialty factories ensures you
receive the right production partner for your product category.

### Built for Scale

We support brands that need reliable, repeatable production—not one-off projects—backed by mature
manufacturing systems.

## FAQs

### How do full-package and CMT manufacturing differ?

Full-package production manages development, sourcing, sampling, and bulk manufacturing under one
workflow. CMT is execution-only—your team provides materials, and we handle cutting, sewing, and
finishing. Brands choose FPP when they want a single accountable partner; they choose CMT when
materials are already secured.

### How should a brand evaluate a clothing manufacturer?

Look for technical capability, a defined production process, and proven experience in your product
category. Reliable communication, transparent timelines, and consistent quality matter far more than
low-cost estimates.

### Do you manufacture in the U.S. or internationally?

Both. We operate from Los Angeles with a network of vetted U.S. and global factories to support

## Step-by-Step Custom Underwear Creation

Discover our step-by-step approach to creating custom underwear.

Customer can provide their own designs or samples. Alternatively, we can create a custom design

### 2. Custom Sample Creation

We will produce a custom sample based on the customer design or sample.

### 3. Fabric Ordering

Once the client approves the sample and makes an initial payment, we begin ordering the bulk fabric.

### 4.Sample Shipment

We use the newly ordered fabric to create another sample and send it to the client. This process
continues until the client is fully satisfied.

### 5. Fabric Cutting

After the customer approves the sample, we proceed with cutting the fabric.

### 6. Production

Once all the fabric has been cut, we begin mass production.

Our quality inspectors rigorously check the finished products. Any defective items are removed.

### 8. Packaging

We pack the products according to the customer specifications. Custom packaging services are also
available.

After packaging is complete, we arrange the shipment. We offer various shipping options.

# Fabric Loader

Fabric is a modular, lightweight mod loader for Minecraft

[Download][7]

### Play

The Fabric Loader download above is the bare minimum. Combine it with Fabric API to get all the
important extra APIs mods use. It has to be put into the mods folder like any other mod.

[ [CurseForge logo] Download Fabric API ][8]
▼
[ [CurseForge logo] CurseForge ][9] [ [Modrinth logo] Modrinth ][10] [ [Github logo] GitHub ][11]

### Develop

Fabric gives you powerful tools to change the game however you like. Use the online [template
generator][12] to get started creating a mod. You can also use the [example mod][13] repository or
[CLI tools][14].

[Develop a mod][15]

### Explore

Extensive documentation is available on the Fabric docs site for both developers and players. Get
additional help from the [Fabric Discord server][16], or ask a question on the [GitHub
Discussion][17] forums.

[Visit the docs][18]

### Core Toolchain Projects
* [Fabric Loader][19] A flexible platform-independent mod loader designed for Minecraft and other
  games and applications.
* [Yarn][20] Yarn is a set of open Minecraft mappings, free for everyone to use under the Creative
  Commons Zero license.
* [Fabric Loom][21] A Gradle plugin enabling developers to easily develop and debug mods.
* [Fabric Language Kotlin][22] This is a mod that enables usage of the Kotlin programming language
  for Fabric mods.
* [Intermediary][23] Intermediary contains match information between different versions of
  Minecraft, enabling cross version mods.
* [Tiny Remapper][24] A tiny, efficient tool for remapping JAR files.
* [Mapping IO][25] A library for reading, manipulating and writing mapping files, with support for a
  wide range of formats.

Thoughtful design meets high-quality fabrics: micro-modal, bamboo, and organic cotton ensure
breathability, softness, and durability—year-round.

**Core Categories**

**Men’s Innerwear:**
Crafted from micro-modal, bamboo, and organic cotton blends, Freecultr’s men’s collection includes
trunks, briefs, vests, undershirts, and boxers. Designed for optimal support and comfort, each piece
is soft, odor-resistant, and long-lasting.

**Women’s Innerwear & Activewear:**

Featuring boy shorts, hipsters, boxer briefs, camisoles, leggings, joggers, tanks, and sweatshirts.
Each item blends comfort and functionality for everyday use and workouts. 

**T‑Shirts & Tees:**

From classic crew necks to sporty tees and Henleys, the cotton collection is essential, versatile,
and ideal for layering or standalone styles. 

**Loungewear & Sleepwear:**

Explore cosy boxers, sweatshirts, co‑ord sets, and sleep suits that offer relaxed silhouettes and
premium comfort. 

**Sweatshirts & “Swearshirts”:**

Unique to Freecultr, these styles—hoodies, sleeveless tops, cropped layers—meld fashion-forward
aesthetics with functional, eco-friendly fabrics. 

**Accessories:**

Eco-conscious bamboo socks (breathable and anti‑odor), stylish bandana masks, arm sleeves, and sling
bags complete the comfort lifestyle.

**Sustainable, Soft, Superior**

**High‑Quality Fabrics:**

 Micro‑Modal: Luxurious feel with antibacterial properties—perfect for innerwear.

 Bamboo: Naturally moisture-wicking, odor-fighting, and eco-friendly—ideal for socks and vests.

 Organic Cotton: Soft, breathable, and responsibly sourced—great for everyday essentials. 

**Eco‑Friendly Practices:**

Freecultr emphasizes sustainability—from fabric choices to packaging and production practices. This
brand is about moving wardrobes toward mindful consumption. 

**Customer-Focused Sizing & Care:**

Products feature a variety of fits (briefs, trunks, boxers, hipsters), detailed size guides, and
washing instructions to preserve wearability. 

**Reviews Speak Volumes**

### FAQ

What makes Freecultr innerwear different from other brands?

Freecultr innerwear is crafted using high quality fabrics like micro-modal, bamboo, and organic
cotton. These materials are ultra-soft, breathable, moisture-wicking, and odor-resistant making them
ideal for everyday comfort. Plus, the brand focuses on sustainable sourcing and long-lasting
quality.

Are Freecultr products eco-friendly and sustainable?

Yes, sustainability is at the heart of Freecultr. The brand uses eco-conscious fabrics like bamboo
and organic cotton, minimizes plastic in packaging, and follows responsible production practices.
Freecultr is committed to reducing its environmental footprint without compromising style or
comfort.

How do I choose the right size for Freecultr underwear or apparel?

Freecultr provides detailed size charts on each product page for both men and women. Use your waist
or bust measurements to match the correct size. If you're between sizes, it’s recommended to size up
for comfort. The brand also offers easy exchanges if sizing doesn’t work out.

Are Freecultr products suitable for sensitive skin?

Absolutely. Freecultr’s micro-modal and bamboo fabrics are naturally hypoallergenic, breathable, and
gentle on skin. They help reduce irritation and rashes, making them an excellent choice for people
with sensitive or allergy-prone skin.

How does Freecultr compare to other premium innerwear brands?

Unlike traditional brands, Freecultr combines **luxury-grade fabrics like micro-modal and bamboo
**with **affordable pricing**. While other brands may compromise on softness or sustainability,
Freecultr ensures every product is **eco-friendly, breathable, and ultra-soft **without breaking the
bank.

Why is Freecultr better for everyday comfort and performance?

Freecultr innerwear and loungewear are engineered for **all-day comfort**. Whether you're at work,
the gym, or relaxing at home, the **moisture-wicking and anti-odor properties **of our fabrics
outperform typical cotton innerwear. You'll stay fresher, drier, and more confident hour after hour.

What sets Freecultr apart in terms of style and design?

Freecultr designs go beyond basics. From vibrant **limited-edition prints **to sleek, minimalist
co-Ord sets and **gender-neutral options**, we offer wardrobe essentials that are **functional yet
fashion-forward**. Our collections keep you looking stylish even when you're dressing down.

Is Freecultr a better value for money than legacy brands?

Absolutely. With Freecultr, you get **premium-quality fabrics**, **modern fits**, and
**eco-conscious production **at a **fraction of the cost **of other premium or international brands.
Plus, our **combo packs, app exclusive discounts, and seasonal offers **give you unbeatable value
year-round.

## Why Lingerie Brands Work With Hello Bra

Hello Bra is operated by Shantou Telige Apparel Co., Ltd. in Shantou, Guangdong, China. The site
supports OEM and ODM projects for private label lingerie brands that need a manufacturing partner
with stable sampling, clear communication, and repeatable quality control. Current development
capability covers seamless bras, sports bras, nursing bras, plus size bras, and matching bra set
programs for fashion and functional collections.

### Factory Support
* Fast quotation and sample evaluation for new styles
* OEM and ODM development for private label programs
* Material, trim, cup, and packaging customization
* QC workflow built for repeat orders and scale Bra Production & Factory Capabilities

### Typical Buyer Questions
* MOQ requirements by bra type and fabric program
* Sample lead time and bulk Bra Production & Factory Capabilities timing
* Size range development and fit review process
* Brand packaging and hangtag coordination

### Factory FAQ

What bra categories can Hello Bra manufacture?

The factory works across seamless bras, sports bras, nursing bras, plus size bras, and coordinated
bra set collections for OEM and ODM customers.

Can you support new brand development as well as repeat styles?

Yes. The workflow supports both new product development and recurring Bra Production & Factory
Capabilities programs, including sampling, revisions, and bulk manufacturing.

What information helps you quote faster?

Reference images, target fabric direction, support level, size range, estimated quantity, and
packaging expectations are the fastest path to an accurate quotation.

# HOM underwear and swimwear — premium comfort for the modern man

Since 1968, HOM has set the standard for men's underwear and swimwear with unmistakable French
quality. From everyday boxers to bold thongs, from fitted swim briefs to relaxed swim shorts — it's
all here. And with sublabel WOH, things get even more daring.

## Underwear that actually fits

HOM understands that underwear is never just an afterthought. The range spans subtle daily boxers
and briefs to eye-catching styles with low waistbands or narrow cuts. **Comfortable fit without
restriction** — that's the baseline for every model. Each design is built for real life, not just
the catalogue.

WOH takes it a step further. This HOM sublabel is made for men who want to stand out: jockstraps,
thongs, and shirts with a bold personality. **Daring, sexy, and unapologetically confident** —
that's the WOH promise.

## Swimwear with a perfect fit

HOM swimwear blends function with style. Whether you go for a fitted swim brief or a looser swim
short, every piece is **resistant to chlorine and salt water** and holds its shape wash after wash.
Available in classic blue, vivid yellow, timeless white and dozens of other colours — solid and
dual-tone options included.

## Easy to order, fast delivery

Not sure about your size? Check our size guide for the perfect fit. Order securely through our
protected checkout and get your parcel delivered quickly. You have 14 days to return — no hassle.
We've been an authorised HOM retailer since 2007 and ship worldwide.

# HOM underwear and swimwear — premium comfort for the modern man

Since 1968, HOM has set the standard for men's underwear and swimwear with unmistakable French
quality. From everyday boxers to bold thongs, from fitted swim briefs to relaxed swim shorts — it's
all here. And with sublabel WOH, things get even more daring.

## Underwear that actually fits

HOM understands that underwear is never just an afterthought. The range spans subtle daily boxers
and briefs to eye-catching styles with low waistbands or narrow cuts. **Comfortable fit without
restriction** — that's the baseline for every model. Each design is built for real life, not just
the catalogue.

WOH takes it a step further. This HOM sublabel is made for men who want to stand out: jockstraps,
thongs, and shirts with a bold personality. **Daring, sexy, and unapologetically confident** —
that's the WOH promise.

## Swimwear with a perfect fit

HOM swimwear blends function with style. Whether you go for a fitted swim brief or a looser swim
short, every piece is **resistant to chlorine and salt water** and holds its shape wash after wash.
Available in classic blue, vivid yellow, timeless white and dozens of other colours — solid and
dual-tone options included.

## Easy to order, fast delivery

Not sure about your size? Check our size guide for the perfect fit. Order securely through our
protected checkout and get your parcel delivered quickly. You have 14 days to return — no hassle.
We've been an authorised HOM retailer since 2007 and ship worldwide.

Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

The Problem

## Procurement doesn't capture the value already sitting in it's existing portfolio...

01 — The reality
Data scattered across multiple systems

Spreadsheets on shared drives. Records in SAP, Oracle, Coupa. Contacts in Outlook. The same supplier
exists three times under three names.

02 — The consequence
No transparency on what you have

You can’t search what you can’t see. Capabilities and risk signals exist in fragments — never as one
queryable picture of your portfolio.

03 — The blind spot
Hidden potential in portfolio and markets

You source new suppliers for capabilities you already have. Existing partners are passed over
because nobody knows what they can do.

04 — The cost
Missed opportunities and market changes

Every new initiative starts from a partial view. Decisions miss the alternatives you never knew
existed.

## Upload spreadsheet.

Our platform turns your portfolio into a workspace that uncovers hidden opportunities already
sitting in your portfolio. 
Procurement teams work with Matchory on a single data layer, all grounded in verified supplier
information.

The Problem

## Procurement doesn't capture the value already sitting in it's existing portfolio...

01 — The reality
Data scattered across multiple systems

Spreadsheets on shared drives. Records in SAP, Oracle, Coupa. Contacts in Outlook. The same supplier
exists three times under three names.

02 — The consequence
No transparency on what you have

You can’t search what you can’t see. Capabilities and risk signals exist in fragments — never as one
queryable picture of your portfolio.

03 — The blind spot
Hidden potential in portfolio and markets

You source new suppliers for capabilities you already have. Existing partners are passed over
because nobody knows what they can do.

04 — The cost
Missed opportunities and market changes

Every new initiative starts from a partial view. Decisions miss the alternatives you never knew
existed.

## Men’s Wearhouse

### Your Destination for Men's Style, Suits & Wardrobe Essentials

Welcome to Men's Wearhouse—the go-to destination for expertly tailored **men’s suits**, premium
dresswear, and versatile **casual clothing**. Whether you're shopping for [deals on prom suits and
tuxedos][206], a wedding, a job interview, or everyday style upgrades, our collection includes
everything from classic tuxedos and modern suits to polished [white dress shirts][207], [black dress
shoes][208], and everyday essentials. We make it easy to look sharp with quality craftsmanship and
size options for every build.

### Style for Every Moment—Formal to Casual

From [modern fit suits][209] to [dinner jackets][210] and [men’s shoes][211], we’ve curated a wide
assortment that adapts to your wardrobe needs. Shop by brand, fit, or collection and enjoy the
confidence of dressing well—whatever your destination.

### Frequently Asked Questions About Men’s Wearhouse

**What types of suits does Men’s Wearhouse offer?**
We offer classic, modern, and slim-fit suits in a variety of fabrics, styles, and price points for
weddings, business, and formal occasions.

**Can I get a custom suit from Men’s Wearhouse?**
Yes, our [custom clothing program][212] lets you personalize your suit from fit to fabric, guided by
experts.

**How can I find the right fit?**
We specialize in inclusive sizing with an extensive [Big & Tall][213] selection across suits,
shirts, and outerwear. Our detailed sport coat and suit [fit guides][214] help you choose your ideal
size and cut.

# Ready. Set. Go.

## Professional, full-featured, modern bags and luggage.

Beautifully integrated pockets, straps and handles. Designed by passionate travelers to have a clean
design, and to provide exceptional functionality and durability for every trip you take. We poured
our hearts into creating luggage to hold your cords, laptops, shoes, and clothes - and still look
high-class while you're boarding your flight.

[See Our Entire Collection][27]
[man holding mercury luggage bag walking through airport]

## Over 70 Years
## of Experience

Quality doesn't happen overnight. It takes decades to perfect - and we've done it. We use durable
materials and experienced craftsmen to create bags and luggage that you'll be proud of for years to
come.

## Made for
## Business Travelers

Balance durability, beautiful design, and functionality - that's what makes a bag for the modern
business traveler. Carry what you need for a three-day business trip - and look awesome while you do
it.

## Modern Appeal
## Modern Functionality

Our luggage embodies modern aesthetics. We design our products with simple yet elegant features and
pair them with considerable utility, ensuring you'll always look the part wherever you go.

[notepad with embroidered logo on a desk]
[person walking with a wheeled duffel bag, embroidered nfl logo on the side]

## Our Story

Founded in 1946, Mercury Luggage® Manufacturing Company began designing high quality luggage and
bags in Jacksonville, Florida. In 1998, Mercury Luggage acquired Seward Trunk® Co. of Petersburg,
Virginia which was founded in 1878 and grew to be the largest domestic manufacturer of trunks and
footlockers in the United States. Mercury Luggage established itself as a premier supplier of high
quality luggage, bags, trunks and cases that are used by major corporations, pro and college sports
teams, top retailers and all branches of the U.S. military.

[Learn More][36]

# Ready. Set. Go.

## Professional, full-featured, modern bags and luggage.

Beautifully integrated pockets, straps and handles. Designed by passionate travelers to have a clean
design, and to provide exceptional functionality and durability for every trip you take. We poured
our hearts into creating luggage to hold your cords, laptops, shoes, and clothes - and still look
high-class while you're boarding your flight.

[See Our Entire Collection][27]
[man holding mercury luggage bag walking through airport]

## Over 70 Years
## of Experience

Quality doesn't happen overnight. It takes decades to perfect - and we've done it. We use durable
materials and experienced craftsmen to create bags and luggage that you'll be proud of for years to
come.

## Made for
## Business Travelers

Balance durability, beautiful design, and functionality - that's what makes a bag for the modern
business traveler. Carry what you need for a three-day business trip - and look awesome while you do
it.

## Modern Appeal
## Modern Functionality

Our luggage embodies modern aesthetics. We design our products with simple yet elegant features and
pair them with considerable utility, ensuring you'll always look the part wherever you go.

## Our Story

Founded in 1946, Mercury Luggage® Manufacturing Company began designing high quality luggage and
bags in Jacksonville, Florida. In 1998, Mercury Luggage acquired Seward Trunk® Co. of Petersburg,
Virginia which was founded in 1878 and grew to be the largest domestic manufacturer of trunks and
footlockers in the United States. Mercury Luggage established itself as a premier supplier of high
quality luggage, bags, trunks and cases that are used by major corporations, pro and college sports
teams, top retailers and all branches of the U.S. military.

[Learn More][36]

## Streamlined Private Label Underwear Manufacturing Process

Discover our rigorous manufacturing approach designed to bring your apparel line to market. We guide
your concepts through every production stage, ensuring absolute **tech-pack compliance**, precision
engineering, and comprehensive **quality control** from yarn to finished product.

## 1. Design Submission

Submit your **tech-packs**, sketches, or physical reference samples. Our design team reviews your
specifications to ensure **production feasibility**.

## 2. Custom Sample Creation

We develop an initial prototype based on your exact design requirements to verify the basic **fit
and silhouette**.

## 3. Pre-Production Sample (PPS) Confirmation

A final **pre-production sample (PPS)** is crafted and sent to you for absolute approval regarding
sizing, fabric, and logo placement before bulk execution.

## 4. Bulk Fabric Procurement & Dyeing

Upon sample approval and initial deposit, we procure premium bulk yarns and execute precise **color
dyeing** to match your brand specifications.

## 5. Fabric Cutting

The dyed fabric undergoes automated **precision cutting** based on your grading specifications to
ensure zero dimensional deviation.

## 6. Bulk Production

Our specialized production lines assemble the underwear, enforcing a strict **13-14 stitches per
inch** precision standard for maximum durability.

## 7. Quality Inspection (AQL 2.5)

We implement a rigorous quality gate adhering to international **AQL 2.5 standards**, passing 100%
of finished goods through advanced **needle detectors**.

## 8. Bespoke Packaging

Products are packed into customized, **sustainable packaging** materials according to your precise
brand labeling requirements.

## 9. Global Shipping

We coordinate seamless logistics options including air, sea, and express freight (DHL/FedEx/UPS) to
deliver cargo directly to your **warehouse**.

## Our Services & B2B Manufacturing Advantages

At Meirumeng (MRM), we operate as a premier source factory specializing in high-quality,
customizable **men’s and women’s underwear OEM/ODM manufacturing**.

Our industrial facility delivers precision-engineered **private label solutions** tailored precisely
to your brand’s technical specifications and volume requirements.

## Pattern Making & Tech-Pack Execution

Our team of experienced technical designers interprets your custom underwear concepts with extreme
precision. Whether you provide detailed **tech-packs** or physical references, we ensure exact
**specification compliance** to bring your product line to life.

## Agile Sampling & Fast Proofing

Accelerate your launch timeline with our rapid prototyping services. We expedite the **sample
development** process, allowing your brand to review, refine, and approve finalized adjustments
without **supply chain delays**.

## Strict Design Confidentiality (NDA)

Your intellectual property is fully secured. We strictly enforce comprehensive **non-disclosure
agreements (NDAs)** to safeguard your unique underwear designs, ensuring they remain entirely
**exclusive to your brand**.

## Certified Quality Assurance

Our production processes strictly adhere to international compliance. Backed by verified **BSCI**,
**OEKO-TEX Standard 100**, **GRS**, and **GOTS** certifications, we guarantee premium, retail-ready
underwear that meets rigorous **global market standards**.

## Advanced Underwear Manufacturing

Operating specialized automated machinery, our facility delivers high-efficiency production. This
industrial capacity enables us to satisfy large-scale **custom OEM/ODM orders** while maintaining
flawless consistency and **on-time delivery**.

## End-to-End One-Stop Solution

At Meirumeng (MRM), we provide a streamlined, full-service manufacturing experience for global
apparel brands. From initial material sourcing to custom packaging and **global logistics**, we
handle every single **production node** seamlessly.

## Streamlined Private Label Underwear Manufacturing Process

Discover our rigorous manufacturing approach designed to bring your apparel line to market. We guide
your concepts through every production stage, ensuring absolute **tech-pack compliance**, precision
engineering, and comprehensive **quality control** from yarn to finished product.

## 1. Design Submission

Submit your **tech-packs**, sketches, or physical reference samples. Our design team reviews your
specifications to ensure **production feasibility**.

## 2. Custom Sample Creation

We develop an initial prototype based on your exact design requirements to verify the basic **fit
and silhouette**.

## 3. Pre-Production Sample (PPS) Confirmation

A final **pre-production sample (PPS)** is crafted and sent to you for absolute approval regarding
sizing, fabric, and logo placement before bulk execution.

## 4. Bulk Fabric Procurement & Dyeing

Upon sample approval and initial deposit, we procure premium bulk yarns and execute precise **color
dyeing** to match your brand specifications.

## 5. Fabric Cutting

The dyed fabric undergoes automated **precision cutting** based on your grading specifications to
ensure zero dimensional deviation.

## 6. Bulk Production

Our specialized production lines assemble the underwear, enforcing a strict **13-14 stitches per
inch** precision standard for maximum durability.

## 7. Quality Inspection (AQL 2.5)

We implement a rigorous quality gate adhering to international **AQL 2.5 standards**, passing 100%
of finished goods through advanced **needle detectors**.

## 8. Bespoke Packaging

Products are packed into customized, **sustainable packaging** materials according to your precise
brand labeling requirements.

## 9. Global Shipping

We coordinate seamless logistics options including air, sea, and express freight (DHL/FedEx/UPS) to
deliver cargo directly to your **warehouse**.

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

## Verification Program

#### The PharmacyChecker Verification team accredits international online pharmacies that meet high
#### standards of pharmacy practice by evaluating them in the [PharmacyChecker International
#### Pharmacy Verification Program][54]. To verify that they meet PharmacyChecker standards,
#### pharmacies must prove adherence to the laws in the countries where they operate in addition to
#### PharmacyChecker policies.

[ [Example PharmacyChecker seal] ][55]
* Prescription orders dispensed by licensed pharmacies
* Requires a Prescription
* International sales of controlled drugs to the U.S. prohibited
* Meets website security requirements
* Publishes customer privacy policy on website
* Publishes contact information on website for customer service
* Pharmacist consultation offered to customers
* Quantities marketed on website restricted to a maximum of 3 months' supply at a time
* Disclosure of pharmacy location to consumer prior to purchase
* Marketing claims are truthful and not misleading
[Find Accredited Pharmacies][56]

PharmacyChecker.com supports the missions of several non-profit organizations to help Americans and
global consumers afford prescription medication, and we encourage you to participate in the advocacy
campaigns of [Prescription Justice][57] and other organizations advocating for access to lower drug
prices.

# PharmacyChecker Research

## **Not Made in the USA**

#### The Global Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and Prospects for Safe Drug Importation

Many consumer products clearly state where those products are made. Not so for prescription
medications. Where our drugs are made and where their main ingredients are sourced affects drug
safety, affordability, availability, and even national security — concerns that have come to the
fore as a result of the global pandemic. Yet there is too little transparency and too much
misinformation surrounding the supply chain of the drugs we take. “Not Made in the USA” investigates
and details the country of manufacture and the source country for active pharmaceutical ingredients
among widely used, brand name prescription drugs.

Rhino designs and manufactures trunks, footlockers and decorative cases for individuals, businesses,
universities, governments, military, retailers and marketing agencies. We take great pride in
building trunks in a variety of finishes including natural wood, leather, faux leathers, fabrics and
custom UV prints. We have extensive in-house printing capabilities. We even make custom road cases,
flight cases and ATA shipping cases. No matter what type of trunk or footlocker you're looking for,
Rhino has an option. Choose from over 200 "stock" possibilities or have us design one to meet your
unique requirements. All our trunks, footlockers and cases are made in Rochester NY USA. That means
high quality and short lead times. Whatever you need, Rhino can deliver.

#### [1. Accept small order][53]

We know that any business grows from small to large, so we are strict and give top support to small

### FAQ

#### [What your MOQ?][58]

Our MOQ is 1000 pcs per design for mens underwear

#### [What's the print provided?][59]

Sublimation print, heat transfer print, or silk-screen print. We suggest a sublimation print for
small order quantities to save logo set-up fees.

#### [What's the sample and mass production lead time?][60]

**Sample production:**
* 5 days if using stock fabric and waistband.
  30 days if make new fabric and waistband.

**Mass production:**
* 30-35 days using stock fabric
* 50-60 days if make new fabric and waistband.

#### [What is the advantage of you compared with other suppliers?][61]

We have long-term processing and manufacturing experience for underwear, cooperating with many
famous brands with high quality and on-time delivery.

#### [What fabric would you be able to offer?][62]

We supply environmentally friendly materials, such as organic cotton, Australian cotton, Modal,
Tencel, Bamboo, Recycle Polyamide, Recycle Polyester, Coolmax, Meryl Skinlife, Meryl, etc.

#### [How can you guarantee the quality?][63]

First, we will adopt the highest standards of raw materials within the customer’s budget.

Second, we boast advanced production equipment that ensures efficiency, coupled with a team of
skilled workers, guaranteeing high-quality output.

Third, random sampling of the entire process before production, during production, and after
completion
of production to ensure the product complies with quality control requirements.

# Over 90 Years of Experience in the Textile Industry

In 1931, Carla Soren Thygesen began a journey that would link the name Thygesen Textile Group
(Denmark) with quality in designing, manufacturing and selling textile products.

**Thygesen Textile Vietnam – Ethical Apparel Manufacturing Partner** is proud to be part of this
incredible journey. Learned from a century of experience and expertise, we are now one of the
leading clothing manufacturers in Vietnam, delivering our goods to the world market.

[Read more][160][Company Profile][161][View Catalogue][162]

Mission

To inspire and motivate change toward True Values and Sustainable Development.

Vision

To become a prestigious textile supplier in Vietnam and worldwide while continually bringing True
Added Values to our customers, partners, employees, and shareholders.

Core Values

From the beginning, Thygesen Textile Vietnam has strived to translate our core values into
everything we do. Truthfulness, Compassion, Kindness, Commitment, and Persistence are what made us a
prestigious and sustainable textile manufacturing company today.

## Product Lines

We specialize in manufacturing **activewear, casualwear, kidswear, underwear, etc.** offering
high-quality apparel to best suit your demands.
Every garment is made with care, in our own **SA8000 and WRAP certified sewing factory**.

[
[activewear manufacturer]
As a trusted activewear manufactuter, our continual research and development of new technology push
advancements in fabric performance and garment construction to provide high-functionality,
breathability and comfort for all activewear from base layer of leggings, sports bras, t-shirts,
polo shirts and hoodies to light outerwear in all seasons.

Activewear Manufacturer

][163][Discover][164]
[
[Casual/Fashionwear Manufacturer]
For an essential product line like Casual & Fashion wear, Thygesen offers various styles, from the
very basic to the most trendy, all up to your requirements. We use natural and eco-friendly
materials such as 100% Cotton, Organic Cotton, BCI Cotton, Cotton/Spandex, Tencel and Bamboo
Viscose/Spandex, ensuring customer satisfaction.

Casual/Fashionwear Manufacturer

][165][Discover][166]
[
[Underwear Manufacturer]
Advanced materials paired with top-tier quality assurance maintain Thygesen’s excellence in the
Underwear product line. Our years of experience have given us extensive knowledge of fabrics,
techniques and design, allowing us to produce underwear that is breathable, absorbent,
antibacterial, quick-drying, odorless and stretch while remaining extraordinarily soft and smooth.

Underwear Manufacturer

][167][Discover][168]
[
[Kidswear Manufacturer]
Thygesen is committed to premium quality and highly functional knitted wear in order to offer the
safest and most comfortable children’s clothing. We can provide a variety of specialty fabrics and
kids’ clothing types that are OEKO-TEX 100 Class I certified.

Kidswear Manufacturer

][169][Discover][170]
[
[Uniform/Workwear Manufacturer]
Our functional workwear is made of high-quality fabric with special technologies. For example, MVS
CVC can withstand industrial washing or Coolmax/Cooldry to keep the body constantly at operating
temperature. The clothing adapts to temperature fluctuations and different weather conditions,
absorbing the sweat and reaching the stability of perfect daily workwear.

Uniform/Workwear Manufacturer

][171][Discover][172]
[
[Medical Devices Manufacturer]
Surrounded by strict product requirements, Thygesen chooses to have our team focus on transparent
quality control and develop products that tested and received international standards such as ISO
13485:2016 and CE marking. We are prepared to have our years of experience and technologies
dedicated to global medical needs.

Medical Devices Manufacturer

][173][Discover][174]

## Our Capabilities

With over **90 years of experience in textile industry**, we support many global fashion brands as a
trusted clothing manufacturer, bringing their designs to life through full-package OEM/ODM
solutions, innovative product development consulting, sustainable and efficient manufacturing.

[Continuous Efforts for R&D]

Continuous Efforts for R&D

Our development team studies your specifications to design readily practical tools, methods and work
instructions, which in combination with the deployment of today’s technology, ensure timely
production and consistent quality standards.
[LEAN Manufacturing System]

LEAN Manufacturing System

Being one of the sustainable clothing manufacturers in Vietnam, we prioritize sustainability and
responsibility in our manufacturing processes. By applying the LEAN system, we minimize waste at
every step and optimize lead time.
[OEM/ODM Manufacturing]

OEM/ODM Manufacturing

We specialize in OEM/ODM manufacturing. Our skillful employees and high-technology machine system
allow us to manage the entire process from development to delivery with precision and efficiency. 
[Certified fabrics]

Certified Fabrics

Based on customer's requirements, we have the capability to source high-quality, sustainable
materials, certified by GOTS, OCS, FSC, GRS, and OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 through our reliable
supplier network in Vietnam and globally.

In 1931, Carla Soren Thygesen began a journey that would link the name Thygesen Textile Group

Mission

Vision

To become a prestigious textile supplier in Vietnam and worldwide while continually bringing True
Added Values to our customers, partners, employees, and shareholders.

Core Values

From the beginning, Thygesen Textile Vietnam has strived to translate our core values into
everything we do. Truthfulness, Compassion, Kindness, Commitment, and Persistence are what made us a
prestigious and sustainable textile manufacturing company today.

## Product Lines

We specialize in manufacturing **activewear, casualwear, kidswear, underwear, etc.** offering
high-quality apparel to best suit your demands.
Every garment is made with care, in our own **SA8000 and WRAP certified sewing factory**.

[
[activewear manufacturer]
As a trusted activewear manufactuter, our continual research and development of new technology push
advancements in fabric performance and garment construction to provide high-functionality,
breathability and comfort for all activewear from base layer of leggings, sports bras, t-shirts,
polo shirts and hoodies to light outerwear in all seasons.

Activewear Manufacturer

][163][Discover][164]
[
[Casual/Fashionwear Manufacturer]
For an essential product line like Casual & Fashion wear, Thygesen offers various styles, from the
very basic to the most trendy, all up to your requirements. We use natural and eco-friendly
materials such as 100% Cotton, Organic Cotton, BCI Cotton, Cotton/Spandex, Tencel and Bamboo
Viscose/Spandex, ensuring customer satisfaction.

Casual/Fashionwear Manufacturer

][165][Discover][166]
[
[Underwear Manufacturer]
Advanced materials paired with top-tier quality assurance maintain Thygesen’s excellence in the
Underwear product line. Our years of experience have given us extensive knowledge of fabrics,
techniques and design, allowing us to produce underwear that is breathable, absorbent,
antibacterial, quick-drying, odorless and stretch while remaining extraordinarily soft and smooth.

Underwear Manufacturer

][167][Discover][168]
[
[Kidswear Manufacturer]
Thygesen is committed to premium quality and highly functional knitted wear in order to offer the
safest and most comfortable children’s clothing. We can provide a variety of specialty fabrics and
kids’ clothing types that are OEKO-TEX 100 Class I certified.

Kidswear Manufacturer

][169][Discover][170]
[
[Uniform/Workwear Manufacturer]
Our functional workwear is made of high-quality fabric with special technologies. For example, MVS
CVC can withstand industrial washing or Coolmax/Cooldry to keep the body constantly at operating
temperature. The clothing adapts to temperature fluctuations and different weather conditions,
absorbing the sweat and reaching the stability of perfect daily workwear.

Uniform/Workwear Manufacturer

][171][Discover][172]
[
[Medical Devices Manufacturer]
Surrounded by strict product requirements, Thygesen chooses to have our team focus on transparent
quality control and develop products that tested and received international standards such as ISO
13485:2016 and CE marking. We are prepared to have our years of experience and technologies
dedicated to global medical needs.

Medical Devices Manufacturer

With over **90 years of experience in textile industry**, we support many global fashion brands as a
trusted clothing manufacturer, bringing their designs to life through full-package OEM/ODM
solutions, innovative product development consulting, sustainable and efficient manufacturing.

[Continuous Efforts for R&D]

Continuous Efforts for R&D

Our development team studies your specifications to design readily practical tools, methods and work
instructions, which in combination with the deployment of today’s technology, ensure timely
production and consistent quality standards.
[LEAN Manufacturing System]

LEAN Manufacturing System

Being one of the sustainable clothing manufacturers in Vietnam, we prioritize sustainability and
responsibility in our manufacturing processes. By applying the LEAN system, we minimize waste at
every step and optimize lead time.
[OEM/ODM Manufacturing]

OEM/ODM Manufacturing

We specialize in OEM/ODM manufacturing. Our skillful employees and high-technology machine system
allow us to manage the entire process from development to delivery with precision and efficiency. 
[Certified fabrics]

Certified Fabrics

Based on customer's requirements, we have the capability to source high-quality, sustainable
materials, certified by GOTS, OCS, FSC, GRS, and OEKO-TEX® Standard 100 through our reliable
supplier network in Vietnam and globally.

## ABOUT US

COMPANY OVERVIEW

### **UNITEX: Your Premier Partner for Integrated Underwear Supply Chain Solutions******

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Xiamen, Xiamen Unitex Trade Co., Ltd. is a leading
manufacturer and exporter specializing in high-quality knitted underwear. We bridge the gap between
world-class design and cost-effective Chinese manufacturing, serving retailers and brands across
Europe, the Americas, and Australia.

#### **Our Heritage & Expertise******

Founded by Will Lin, a textile industry veteran with over 20 years of experience (since 2004),
Unitex was built on a simple yet powerful mission: To provide global brands with direct-from-factory
pricing without compromising on service or quality. 

**Why Partner with Unitex?**

Vertical Integration: We combine our agile Xiamen headquarters with a robust manufacturing base in
Southeast China. This allows us to offer the efficiency of a professional trading service backed by
the competitive pricing of a 200-worker factory.

# Professional OEM Underwear Manufacturer

Since 1993

Yejie Underwear is a professional OEM and ODM manufacturer with production bases in Yiwu and
Guangdong, China. Founded in 1993, we specialize in all types of underwear – including seamless,
seamed, and viscose styles for men, women, and children. With over 30 years of manufacturing
experience, we serve both domestic and international clients across North America, South America,
Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. We offer 7-day sampling, hundreds of fabric options,
and flexible order quantities – from as low as 100 pcs for ready-stock items to 6,000 pcs for custom
production. Whether you're a global brand or a growing retailer, Yejie provides reliable quality,
competitive pricing, and on-time delivery you can trust.

## From Concept to Delivery

Our proven 5-step manufacturing process is designed to support consistent quality, reliable delivery
timelines, and clear communication throughout your project.

01

### Design & Development

Our design and sampling team works closely with you to turn your ideas into reality. Whether you
send a physical sample, photo, or tech pack, we can recreate any style typically within 7 days. We
provide pattern development, size grading, and 3D fitting support to make sure your prototype meets
brand requirements before mass production.

02

### Material Selection

We source fabrics directly from certified suppliers in Yiwu and Guangdong, covering cotton, nylon,
viscose, modal, bamboo fiber, and other specialty blends. Our material library includes functional
options like moisture-wicking, antibacterial, stretch-control, and temperature-regulating fabrics.
We also provide specialty fabrics that are less commonly available in the market, giving your brand
a unique edge.

03

### Production

Mass production takes place in our Yiwu and Guangdong manufacturing facilities equipped with
advanced seamless knitting machines, automatic cutters, and computerized sewing systems. Our skilled
technicians ensure consistency and precision across every order. Production timelines typically
range from 15–30 days, depending on order size and customization requirements.

04

### Quality Control

Each order follows a multi-stage quality control process, including raw material inspection, in-line
production checks, and final pre-shipment inspection. Our quality management system operates in
accordance with ISO 9001 standards, with strict controls on fit, color consistency, elasticity, and
stitching strength before packing.

05

### Delivery

Once approved, products are professionally packed with your custom branding — including printed
boxes, hang tags, or woven labels as required. We offer air, sea, and express shipping options to
multiple international markets, including North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle
East. Our team provides shipment tracking and after-sales support to support safe and timely
delivery.
